phase: formula-pass (blind; stage A packet only; no claims seen)

identity.normalization: Canonical list one entry per ingredient; no split synonyms; no markers. Normalized one-based positions (ID-2) = packet positions.
identity.e3ProminenceCutoff: Parfum @7 is the E3 marker. Prominent = positions 1-6.

surfactants.c3Class: not a cleansing route and not a buffer (low-ethoxylate Laureth-n)

weak_refatter: Lauryl Lactate@4 (light refatting alkyl lactate ester; prominent) - see uncertainties for the payload_lipid reading

exposure.fragranceAllergens: none from the closed list declared
exposure.coolingAgents: Menthol@8 (directly after Parfum; not prominent under E3)

formulaFacts.mildBase: Not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 excludes MB.
formulaFacts.csa: Not met: no listed E4 route is prominent (Allantoin@11, Bisabolol@12, Glycerin@17 are after Parfum@7) and MB is excluded by SLES@2. Prominent unlisted candidate to name if a gate fails: unlisted_route_candidate:Lauryl Lactate (rejected by R18).

wLine.plausibility: No candidate at positions 1-6. E3 marker Parfum@7 (class a): (i) SLES@2 listed before; (ii) nothing between it and the cap. Plausible; W-line = cap.
wLine.note: No payload_lipid under the chosen reading. If Lauryl Lactate@4 were read as a payload_lipid (emollient ester), it would be material (4 < W-line 7).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 buffered by the prominent amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3; no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-4@9 is not a cleansing route (C3). Refatter Lauryl Lactate@4 is a counter-signal only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system (prominent cationic guar@5) plus a prominent pearlizing route (Glycol Distearate@6) and a light refatting ester (Lauryl Lactate@4); humectant Glycerin@17 is late. C2 not met because there is no early silicone and Lauryl Lactate is read as weak_refatter, which never replaces the silicone leg. Neighbor high: if Lauryl Lactate@4 is read as a prominent payload_lipid (6.3 'emollient esters'), C2 is met (lipid + guar + pearlizer + Glycerin) and W-RICH holds for conditioning.

weightPotential.wLine: Parfum@7 (fragrance; = cap). payload_lipid: none material, none non-material under the weak_refatter reading of Lauryl Lactate; under the alternative reading Lauryl Lactate@4 would be the one material member.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - a cationic guar high in the list (5, before the pearlizer and Parfum) converging with an early refatting ester (4).
weightPotential.persistence: moderate - guar deposits through dilution and can accumulate; the light lactate ester is weakly retained.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate - C1 SLES/betaine chassis with a single buffer.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Reset is an effective ordinary chassis; Lauryl Lactate is a light, non-greasy ester; no silicone.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate anchor: one meaningfully persistent system (early guar) interacting with a refatting ester plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue; the moderate reset and the lightness of the ester argue against a coating result.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: the guar is prominent at position 5 and converges with an early ester at 4, so calling the product lightweight would understate residue risk (W2). Not high: with Lauryl Lactate read as a weak refatter there is only one persistent deposition family; even under the payload_lipid reading W-RICH would hold but reset is moderate (not limited), so high would need persistent convergence that a light lactate ester does not plausibly provide (W-RICH limited-reset clause, which names high as the neighbor).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Family reading of Lauryl Lactate@4 (weak_refatter vs payload_lipid emollient ester) and guar dose.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (moderate confidence): early guar + early refatting ester against moderate C1 reset; high is the neighbor because of the payload_lipid reading of Lauryl Lactate.

careDirection.limitation: Blind; no humectant or protein cluster; generic conditioning.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Menthol cooling and an ordinary moderate chassis; formula is clarifying-compatible under F6 (cleansing moderate, conditioning not high, weight not high) if an oily/reset claim appears.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula-compatible routes: clarifying (F6 compatible), scalp_active only with SC1 (but CSA fails). Decision: provisional general pending claims.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): default regular; cleansing not strong, so frequent fires with U2 wording; alternating impossible (not strong); treatment impossible.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted whatever the claims: CSA fails - Allantoin@11, Bisabolol@12 and Glycerin@17 are listed after Parfum@7, so no listed E4 route is prominent, and MB is excluded by SLES@2. Prominent unlisted Lauryl Lactate@4 does not count (rejected by R18). Menthol@8 recorded as exposure. Sensitive/dry positioning would lead to S-FAIL naming unlisted_route_candidate:Lauryl Lactate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: no recognized anti-dandruff active; menthol does not upgrade it.

uncertainties: Lauryl Lactate@4 weight family: read as weak_refatter ('light refatting esters', 6.3). Alternative: payload_lipid ('emollient esters/ethers', 6.3) - it would then be material (before W-line Parfum@7), C2 would be met for conditioning (-> high) and W-RICH would hold for weight with moderate reset (-> moderate with high as neighbor, or high if its convergence with guar were read as persistent). Recorded via neighbors: conditioning neighbor high, weight neighbor high.
Menthol@8 sits directly after Parfum@7: not prominent under E3, so it is not a CSA counter-signal by the letter of Section 10; noted as exposure.
